Later history preserved the datatype through FHIR-14384 and the R4 lensSpecification refactor.
additional_context: VisionPrescription is active in source/fhir.ini. The current elements are VisionPrescription.lensSpecification.eye and VisionPrescription.lensSpecification.prism.base; source/fhir.ini rename metadata maps the old dispense.base path to prism.base. FHIR-14384 is already represented on the combined branch and explains the later prism.base path without changing the FHIR-12516 datatype decision. Zulip discussion from 2017-01-04 supports using code for required-bound fields; Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition has both relevant current elements as primitive code with required VisionEyes/VisionBase bindings, and there are no obsolete dispense.eye/base definitions under source/visionprescription.
